verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a context-routing and evaluation layer for teams' existing AI agents. Per its docs, it delivers context edits mid-conversation and rewrites tool descriptions, schemas and tool results, but it is not itself an agent that calls tools. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is an agent-client capability, so this axis does not fit the product's type. Nothing in the evidence shows it acting as an MCP client.
